features.name: Business Central Telemetry
features.description: Opt-in usage data collection for business Central environments tracking usage patterns, errors, performance, and changes. Designed to be privacy compliant and GDPR conformant.
caveats: opt-in feature
requires administrator setup

features.name: Business Central Usage App
features.description: A Power BI hosted application with four different reports - usage, error, performance, and administration reports - providing visualization of telemetry data across multiple environments.
caveats: must be installed from Power BI App Source

features.name: DAU/WAU/MAU Report
features.description: Tracks daily, weekly, and monthly active users in business Central environments. Shows usage growth patterns and user adoption across go-live phases.
caveats: includes multiple environments if configured
patterns differ by business cycle

features.name: Sessions Report
features.description: Shows user types, client types used (Teams, phone, web), login patterns across days and weeks, and configurable time windows for data analysis.
caveats: time window configurable at install time

features.name: Client Types and Browser Report
features.description: Reports on which browsers and clients (tablet, phone, desktop) users access business Central with, and screen sizes, useful for UI design decisions.

features.name: User Locations Report
features.description: Maps user login locations and shows language preferences set by users in their client configuration.

features.name: Change Report
features.description: Tracks environment and extension changes across all environments and dimensions, showing what changed, when it changed, and which components were affected.

features.name: Sensitive Field Monitoring
features.description: Administrator feature to track changes to sensitive fields like credit card or bank information. Logs who changed it, when, and which field in which table, but does not log the actual data changed.
caveats: only logs metadata, not actual data values
administrator configuration required

features.name: Page Views Report
features.description: Shows which pages in the Business Central client have been visited by users, with statistics on visit frequency and timing patterns across days and weeks.

features.name: Application Highlights Report
features.description: Shows which places in the base application were touched or tested by users during testing phases, organized by functional area like finance.
caveats: absence of data may indicate areas not tested or not in scope

features.name: Reports Usage Report
features.description: Tracks which reports users have been running, including whether they downloaded, previewed, or printed reports, with timing patterns by day and week.

features.name: Feature Telemetry
features.description: Developers can instrument every part of the application with feature telemetry events to track how often particular features are used during testing.

features.name: Integrations Page in Telemetry
features.description: A page showing integrations to and from Business Central including apps published by Microsoft and third-party installed apps, allowing teams to test external system integrations during user acceptance testing.

features.name: Statistical Accounts
features.description: A new finance feature coming in version 22.2.0 that can be tested during user acceptance testing to verify permission setup and proper usage.
features.status_evidence_quote: statistical accounts this is a new feature by the way coming in version 22 2.0 in the finance
caveats: This is coming in version 22.2.0, not yet released at time of presentation

features.name: Error Message Feedback Voting
features.description: Users can provide feedback on whether error messages are helpful through a voting system that allows customization and improvement of user experience during go-live preparation.

features.name: Error Dashboard
features.description: Displays all types of errors that happen in Business Central including user errors, integration errors, and system errors, allowing project teams to track and address issues before go-live.

features.name: KPI Tracking in Error Report
features.description: Error report pages include KPIs that track changes in errors over time such as 'since yesterday' and 'last seven days' to monitor progress in driving errors to zero during go-live.
caveats: Requires manual checking across multiple pages in the error report

features.name: Power BI Metrics
features.description: A Power BI feature available with a pro license that allows creation of scorecards and metrics to automatically track KPI changes over time and send notifications to Teams when metrics reach certain states.
caveats: Requires Power BI Pro license at $10 USD per month

features.name: Usage Report
features.description: A Power BI report showing which pages, reports, features and integrations have been used during user acceptance testing, helping teams verify that key areas were actually tested.

features.name: Excel layouts for reports
features.description: End users can create report layouts using Excel by exporting data, adding pivot tables and custom formatting, then uploading the template back to business Central. This moves layout responsibility from developers to end users.
caveats: Requires end user Excel skills
Template management needed when uploading

features.name: Connectors report showing integrations
features.description: Telemetry report that displays integrations into business Central from Teams, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps, enabling partners to identify expansion opportunities.
caveats: Absence of data indicates untapped integration opportunities

features.name: Application areas usage in telemetry
features.description: Telemetry tracks usage of different application areas in business Central, such as fixed assets. This helps identify functionality the customer is paying for but not using.
caveats: Requires training and adoption planning when implementing new areas

features.name: Application Insights resource setup
features.description: Azure Application Insights is used as the backend resource to store business Central telemetry data. It must be created in Azure before configuring business Central.
caveats: Requires Azure subscription
Customer or partner can own the resource

features.name: Business Central telemetry configuration
features.description: Telemetry is configured through the tenant admin center by defining application insights connection string. Configuration causes environment restart so must be done outside working hours.
caveats: Environment restart required - must be done during off-hours
Connection string must be carefully copied

features.name: Power BI business Central usage analytics app
features.description: Official Power BI app available on Microsoft AppSource that visualizes business Central telemetry data with configurable data retention windows and nightly refresh cycles.
caveats: Requires Power BI license
Same organization owning Application Insights should install app
App refresh is nightly only

features.name: Telemetry version support back to version 15
features.description: Telemetry capability is supported from business Central version 15 onwards, with version 22 releasing April 2023. Higher versions provide more data types.
caveats: Earlier versions have fewer data types available
Newer versions recommended for broader telemetry
